boundary: JPAPlanetImpl.initialize (JPAPlanetImpl.java:72): the unit is hand-made in JPAPersistenceStrategy, which begins its transaction lazily at the first write. JPAPropertiesManagerImpl.getProperties (op 1, a read with FlushModeType.COMMIT) runs before any write and auto-commits outside the unit. The unit really begins at the first JPAPersistenceStrategy.store call inside saveProperties's loop (JPAPropertiesManagerImpl.java:147) and commits at JPAPlanetImpl.initialize:38 (flush()).

ops_remove.note: JPAPropertiesManagerImpl.getProperties (JPAPropertiesManagerImpl.java:114) runs through getEntityManager(false): no transaction open yet, runs and auto-commits before the first write starts the lazily-begun unit (app fact).

ops_fix.note: saveProperties loops over properties.values(), a Map<String, RuntimeConfigProperty> (JPAPropertiesManagerImpl.java:142/172), so the Object argument to strategy.store is always a RuntimeConfigProperty -> roller_properties, not unknown.

notes: Shape becomes single-write (one write) after removing the pre-write read.
